_comment: A worked example. Copy to data/profile.json, replace everything, chmod 600.
This file is the single place anything personal lives. The scoring prompt,
the gap analysis and the cover letters are all built from it, so the more
honest and specific it is, the better every one of them gets.
The real profile is never committed - .gitignore covers data/.

_comment: This section builds the scoring prompt. The ladder is your own order of
preference - the model's job is to place a posting on it, not to have
opinions about your career. Be blunt; it reads better than being fair.
search.summary: Twelve years in IT support and systems administration, the last four leading a service desk for a 900-seat manufacturer. Windows Server and Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, VMware, networking and VLANs, backup and recovery, PowerShell and Python scripting, and a home lab running Docker, Proxmox and Terraform.

ladder.families: Systems administrator, infrastructure engineer, IT manager.
ladder.note: Work already done - any level is fine.

ladder.families: Cloud operations, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE.
ladder.note: The move being made. Junior and associate titles welcome.

ladder.families: Security operations, SOC analyst, vulnerability management.
Service desk and desktop support at any tier, IT technician.
Adjacent technical work that leads toward the above: field service, AV, low voltage, data analyst.

search.not_my_field: sales, account management, marketing, finance, accounting, clinical or medical, nursing, teaching, driving, warehouse, food service, administrative assistant, human resources, customer success, project coordination, ERP or application consulting, business analysis
